sentences.en: Today we continue our series on ecology and conservation with a look at a particularly endangered member of the black bear family
sentences.zh: 今天，我们继续生态学与保护系列专题，聚焦黑熊家族中一种特别濒危的成员。

sentences.en: One in ten black bears is actually born with
sentences.zh: 十分之一的黑熊天生就拥有

sentences.en: a white coat, which is the result of a special gene that surfaces in a few
sentences.zh: 白色皮毛，这是由一种特殊基因导致的，该基因仅在少数个体中显现。

sentences.en: Local people have named it 'the spirit bear'
sentences.zh: 当地人称它为‘灵熊’。

sentences.en: And according to the legends of these communities, its snowy fur
sentences.zh: 根据这些社区的传说，它雪白的皮毛

sentences.en: brings with it a special power
sentences.zh: 赋予其一种特殊的力量。

sentences.en: Because of this, it has always been highly regarded by them so much that they do not speak of seeing it to anyone else
sentences.zh: 正因如此，它一直受到当地人的高度尊崇，甚至到了不愿向他人透露自己曾见过它的程度。

sentences.en: It is their way of protecting it
sentences.zh: 这是他们保护灵熊的方式。

sentences.en: when strangers visit the area
sentences.zh: 当陌生人造访该地区时。

sentences.en: The white bear's habitat is quite interesting
sentences.zh: 白熊的栖息地颇为有趣。

sentences.en: The bear's strong relationship with the old- growth rainforest is a complex one
sentences.zh: 白熊与原始温带雨林之间存在着一种复杂而紧密的关系。

sentences.en: The white bear relies on the huge centuries-old trees in the forest in many ways
sentences.zh: 白熊在许多方面都依赖森林中那些已有数百年树龄的参天古木。

sentences.en: For example, the old-growth trees have extremely long roots that help prevent erosion of the soil along the banks of the many fish streams
sentences.zh: 例如，这些原始林木拥有极其发达的长根系，有助于防止众多鲑鱼溪流沿岸土壤的侵蚀。

sentences.en: Keeping these banks intact is important because these streams are home to salmon, which are the bear's main food source
sentences.zh: 保持溪岸完整至关重要，因为这些溪流是鲑鱼的家园，而鲑鱼正是熊的主要食物来源。

sentences.en: In return, the bear's feeding habits nurture the forest
sentences.zh: 作为回报，熊的觅食习性又滋养着森林。

sentences.en: As the bears eat the salmon, they discard the skin and bones in great amounts on the forest floor, which provide vital nutrients
sentences.zh: 当熊捕食鲑鱼时，会将大量鱼皮和鱼骨遗弃在森林地表，从而提供至关重要的养分。

sentences.en: These produce lush vegetation that sustains thousands of other types of life forms, from birds to insects and more
sentences.zh: 这些养分催生出茂盛的植被，维系着从鸟类、昆虫到其他各类生命形式共数千种生物的生存。

sentences.en: Today, the spirit bear lives off the coast of the province of British Columbia on a few islands
sentences.zh: 如今，灵熊仅分布于不列颠哥伦比亚省沿海的若干岛屿上。

sentences.en: There is great concern for their survival since it is estimated that less than two hundred of these white bears remain
sentences.zh: 人们对其生存状况深感忧虑，因为据估计现存白熊数量不足两百只。

sentences.en: The best way to protect them is to make every effort to preserve the delicate balance of their forest environment - in other words, their ecosystem
sentences.zh: 保护它们的最佳方式，是竭尽全力维系其森林环境的微妙平衡——换言之，即维系其生态系统。

sentences.en: The greatest threat to the bear's existence is the loss of its habitat
sentences.zh: 对灵熊生存构成的最大威胁，是其栖息地的丧失。

sentences.en: Over many years, logging companies have stripped the land by cutting down a large number of trees
sentences.zh: 多年来，伐木公司通过砍伐大量树木，使土地变得光秃裸露。

sentences.en: In addition, they have built roads which have fractured the areas where the bear usually and many hibernation sites have also been lost
sentences.zh: 此外，它们还修建了道路，割裂了熊类通常活动的区域，许多冬眠地点也因此消失。

sentences.en: The logging of the trees along the streams has damaged the places where the bears fish
sentences.zh: 沿溪流进行的伐木作业，已破坏了熊类捕鱼的场所。

sentences.en: To make matters worse, the number of salmon in those streams is declining because there is no legal limit on fishing
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，由于目前尚无法律限制捕鱼量，这些溪流中的鲑鱼数量正在持续减少。

sentences.en: at the moment
sentences.zh: 目前。

sentences.en: All these influences have a negative impact on the spirit bear's very existence, which is made all the more fragile by the fact that reproduction among these bears has always been disappointingly low
sentences.zh: 所有这些影响均对灵熊的生存造成负面影响；而这种脆弱性又因灵熊一贯偏低的繁殖率而进一步加剧。

sentences.en: And so, what's the situation going forward?
sentences.zh: 那么，未来形势将如何发展？

sentences.en: Community organizations, environmental groups and the British Columbia government are now working together on the problem
sentences.zh: 社区组织、环保团体以及不列颠哥伦比亚省政府如今正携手应对这一问题。

sentences.en: The government is now requiring logging companies to adopt a better logging method, which is a positive step
sentences.zh: 政府目前已要求伐木公司采用更可持续的伐木方法，这是一个积极的进展。

sentences.en: However, these measures alone may not be sufficient to ensure a healthy population of the spirit bear in the future
sentences.zh: 然而，单靠这些措施可能还不足以确保灵熊未来拥有健康的种群数量。

sentences.en: Other steps also need to be taken
sentences.zh: 还需采取其他举措。

sentences.en: While it is important to maintain the spirit bear's habitat, there also needs to be more emphasis on its expansion
sentences.zh: 在维护灵熊现有栖息地的同时，也需更加重视其栖息地的拓展。

sentences.en: The move is justified as it will also create space for other bears that are losing their homes
sentences.zh: 此举具有充分合理性，因为它还将为那些正失去家园的其他熊类腾出空间。
